description: Fetch a search's leads with verification filled in as enrichment progresses. Poll until enrichment is 'complete'. Each lead includes verified emails (SMTP status), verified phones (line type + carrier), owner name where identified, socials, and the business profile.

search_id.description: The search_id returned by search_leads or enrich_domains.

name: get_search_results

leads_remaining.description: Leads spendable now. On a plan with no monthly quota this is what is left in the current 7-day period, not a monthly balance.

next_offset.description: Pass as offset to fetch the next page; null on the last page.

period.description: On a rate-limited plan: { limit, used, resets_at }. Null on a metered plan.

progress.description: { done, total } rows enriched so far.

queue_position.description: For queued searches, the place in this account's own queue (1 = next).

address.description: Street address from the Google listing.

claimed.description: Whether the owner has claimed the Google listing.

email_status.description: Email 1's SMTP verdict: safe | risky | invalid | unknown.

google_cid.description: Google listing id (the query_leads google_cid field).

maps_url.description: The Google Maps link for the listing.

phone_line_type.description: Phone 1's line type: mobile, fixed_line, voip or toll_free usually; also unknown, fixed_line_or_mobile and the other values query_leads lists.

phones_data.description: Verified phones with line type + carrier.

primary_email.description: Email 1: the first address in emails_data, the one email_status describes. Before emails are verified, the lead's primary address.

primary_phone.description: Phone 1: the first number in phones_data, the one phone_line_type describes. Before phones are verified, the lead's primary number, or its Google Maps number.

socials.description: Social profile links keyed by platform.

stage.description: queued | discovering | enriching | verifying | complete | failed | cancelled. 'verifying' means every row is delivered and contacts are being verified — often the longest phase, not a stall.

title: Get search results
